Collect the terms in $y$ on one side: $y(2x - 3) = 5x + 3$, so $y = \dfrac{5x + 3}{2x - 3}$. Check with one point: $f(0) = -\dfrac{3}{5}$, and the inverse sends $-\dfrac{3}{5}$ back to $0$.
